sentences.text: Of the patients randomized, {F:14.1.1.randomized.velo|n} were assigned to velorantib and {F:14.1.1.randomized.pbo|n} to placebo.
The treatment period was completed by {F:14.1.1.completed.velo} patients in the velorantib group and {F:14.1.1.completed.pbo} patients in the placebo group.

The most common reason for discontinuation was withdrawal by the patient ({F:14.1.1.disc_withdrawal.velo} and {F:14.1.1.disc_withdrawal.pbo}, respectively), followed by adverse events ({F:14.1.1.disc_ae.velo} and {F:14.1.1.disc_ae.pbo}).
Treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) were reported for {F:14.3.1.1.any_teae.velo} patients in the velorantib group and {F:14.3.1.1.any_teae.pbo} patients in the placebo group.
TEAEs considered related to study drug by the investigator occurred in {F:14.3.1.1.related_teae.velo} and {F:14.3.1.1.related_teae.pbo} patients, respectively.
The most frequently reported TEAE was hypotension, which was significantly more common with velorantib ({F:14.3.1.2.hypotension.velo}) than with placebo ({F:14.3.1.2.hypotension.pbo}).
sentences.seededIssue: STAT-001: 'significantly' used without a statistical test for this comparison

sentences.text: Dizziness was reported in {F:14.3.1.2.dizziness.velo} and {F:14.3.1.2.dizziness.pbo} patients, and hyperkalaemia in {F:14.3.1.2.hyperkalaemia.velo} and {F:14.3.1.2.hyperkalaemia.pbo} patients, in the velorantib and placebo groups, respectively.
TEAEs leading to discontinuation of study drug occurred in {F:14.3.1.1.disc_teae.velo} patients receiving velorantib and {F:14.3.1.1.disc_teae.pbo} patients receiving placebo.

sections.title: Deaths and other serious adverse events

sentences.text: Serious TEAEs were reported for {F:14.3.1.1.sae.velo} patients in the velorantib group and {F:14.3.1.1.sae.pbo} patients in the placebo group.

Deaths were reported for {F:14.3.1.1.death.velo} patients in the velorantib group and {F:14.3.1.1.death.pbo} patients in the placebo group; investigator causality for each death is given in the patient narratives (Section 14.3.3).
Narratives for all patients with serious TEAEs are provided in Section 14.3.3.
